issues.description: Attribute 'number_of_qubits_query_register' has incompatible types between the template and the solution. In the template (template_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py) the attribute is assigned a float literal (0.0), while in the reference solution (solution_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py) it is an integer (4). The problem statement asks students to initialize the number of qubits for the 2x2 Kakuro exercise. Using a float here will cause QuantumRegister(...) to receive a non-integer size and raise a TypeError at circuit construction, blocking students from running or testing their code.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the float literal in the template with an integer placeholder that matches the intended number of query qubits. For example: self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 4  # integer placeholder. Ensure the value is an int before constructing QuantumRegister to avoid runtime TypeError.
